"'''(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] performed by [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]], a band formed<ref name="SWI 67" /> during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> a conflict that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> At some point before [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="SWI 67" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," including the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> his band made three recordings and a name for themselves with crowd-pleasers such as "(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate."<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
"(That Joyous Night) I Ate My Mate" was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article written by [[Rich Handley]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
